name: v_cloudflare_pageviews
comment: Browser pageview analytics excluding background prefetches, RSC payloads, API routes, static assets, and crawlers
statement:
FROM scopedb.public.cloudflare_worker_events
WHERE event_type = 'worker.invocation'
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    method,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    attributes['continent']::string AS continent,
    attributes['country']::string AS country,
    attributes['region']::string AS region,
    attributes['city']::string AS city,
    attributes['timezone']::string AS timezone,
    attributes['colo']::string AS colo,
    attributes['as_organization']::string AS as_organization,
    if(
        attributes['referer_host']::string = host
            OR attributes['referer_host']::string = concat('www.', host)
            OR concat('www.', attributes['referer_host']::string) = host,
        NULL,
        attributes['referer_host']::string
    ) AS referer_host,
    if(
        attributes['referer_host']::string = host
            OR attributes['referer_host']::string = concat('www.', host)
            OR concat('www.', attributes['referer_host']::string) = host,
        NULL,
        attributes['referer_path']::string
    ) AS referer_path,
    attributes['utm_source']::string AS utm_source,
    attributes['utm_medium']::string AS utm_medium,
    attributes['utm_campaign']::string AS utm_campaign,
    attributes['ref']::string AS ref,
    attributes['user_agent']::string AS user_agent,
    attributes['sec_fetch_mode']::string AS sec_fetch_mode,
    attributes['sec_fetch_dest']::string AS sec_fetch_dest,
    attributes['is_prefetch']::boolean AS is_prefetch,
    attributes['is_rsc']::boolean AS is_rsc,
    attributes['verified_bot_category']::string AS verified_bot_category,
    attributes['wall_time_ms']::float AS wall_time_ms,
    attributes['cpu_time_ms']::float AS cpu_time_ms
WHERE method = 'GET'
  AND status = 200
  AND path IS NOT NULL
  AND (is_prefetch IS NULL OR NOT is_prefetch)
  AND (is_rsc IS NULL OR NOT is_rsc)
  AND verified_bot_category IS NULL
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/api/')
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/_next/')
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/_app/')
  AND NOT starts_with(path, '/.')
  AND NOT ends_with(path, '/__data.json')
  AND NOT regexp_like(path, regex => '(?i)[.](md|txt|xml|ico|svg|png|jpg|jpeg|webp|gif|css|js|map|json|woff2?)$')
  AND (user_agent IS NULL OR NOT regexp_like(user_agent, regex => '(?i)(bot|crawler|spider|slurp|facebookexternalhit|feedbin|pingwatch|uptime|statuscake|cortex-xpanse|paloaltonetworks|censys|shodan|zgrab|curl|wget|python|go-http-client|axios|node-fetch|undici|okhttp|headless|Claude-User|Cursor|Codex)'))
